# REST API contract

**Version:** 0.1 draft (2026-11-20) — to be frozen as 1.0 by T-012; grows by minor versions per task.
**Changelog:** 0.1 initial route list from source §10.2 (FR-8.4).
**Schema source:** route schemas in `packages/contracts/src/api/`; snapshot `openapi.json` generated by
`apps/api` and checked by contract tests.

Base path `/api`. Auth: session cookie (web) or `Authorization: Bearer <API token>` (agents, OQ-020).
Errors: `{ error: <code>, message, issues? }`. Lists: `?cursor=&limit=` (≤ 100), response `{ items, next_cursor }`.

| Method | Path | Purpose | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` (no `/api` prefix) | dependency status, `X-Release-Version` header | R1 |
| POST | `/api/auth/*` | sign-in / sign-out / invitations (OQ-002, OQ-028) | R1 |
| GET/POST | `/api/organizations`, `/api/organizations/:orgId/members` | organizations, members | R1 |
| GET/POST/PATCH | `/api/projects`, `/api/projects/:projectId` | projects | R1 |
| GET/POST | `/api/projects/:projectId/members` | project members | R1 |
| GET/POST | `/api/projects/:projectId/repositories` | register repositories | R1 |
| GET/POST/PATCH | `/api/projects/:projectId/tasks`, `/api/tasks/:taskId` | tasks (`PATCH` checks source ownership, FR-8.3) | R1 |
| POST | `/api/tasks/:taskId/comments` | comments | R1 |
| GET/POST/PATCH | `/api/projects/:projectId/documents`, `/api/documents/:id`, `/api/documents/:id/versions` | documents, history, restore | R1 |
| GET | `/api/projects/:projectId/activity` | timeline | R1 |
| GET | `/api/events/stream?project_id=` | SSE stream (FR-9.13) | R1 |
| POST | `/api/integrations/events` | event intake (event-envelope-contract.md) | R2 |
| POST | `/api/webhooks/github` | GitHub webhooks (github-integration.md) | R2 |
| GET/POST | `/api/repositories/:id/integration`, `/sync`, `/health` | integration config, trigger sync, diagnostics | R2 |
| GET | `/api/projects/:projectId/context/*` | context engine (overview, tasks, activity, decisions, requirements) | R3 |
| GET/POST | `/api/tokens` | API tokens | R3 |
| GET/POST/PATCH | `/api/projects/:projectId/requirements`, `/api/requirements/:id/versions` | requirements | R4 |
| POST | `/api/projects/:projectId/change-requests` | change requests | R4 |
| GET/POST | `/api/projects/:projectId/approvals`, `/qa-results`, `/design-references`, `/shares` | collaboration | R4 |
| GET | `/api/reports/*` | reports | R4 |

## SSE

`GET /api/events/stream?project_id=…` → `text/event-stream`. Each message: `event: <change type>`,
`data: { entity_type, entity_id, project_id, change, occurred_at }`. Change types: `task.changed`,
`pull_request.merged`, `requirement.approved`, `document.published`, `qa.completed`, `milestone.changed`.
Only changes the subscriber may read are sent (FR-9.14). Heartbeat comment every 25 s.
